concept.title: For rear left and right seat (for Europe, Australia and New Zealand)

li.p: When the vehicle is POWER ON or DRIVE READY, the warning light will illuminate for approximately 6 seconds. The warning light will continue to stay illuminated until the seat belt is fastened. If no passengers are detected, the warning light will activate for approximately 6 seconds and then turn off.

If the seat belt is unfastened while driving and the vehicle’s speed is below approximately 20 km/h (12 mph), the warning light will remain illuminated. If the vehicle’s speed is above approximately 20 km/h (12 mph) and the seat belt is unfastened while driving, the warning light (flashing) and warning sound will operate for about 35 seconds. After that, the warning light will continue to stay illuminated until the seat belt is fastened.
